layout: transform
name: invasion of kaldheim
mana cost: {3}{R}
types: battle siege
defense: 4
triggered: when CARDNAME enters, exile all cards from your hand, then draw that many cards. until the end of your next turn, you may play cards exiled this way.
triggered: when CARDNAME is defeated, exile it, then cast it transformed.
replacement: CARDNAME enters with four defense counters on it.

ALTERNATE

name: pyre of the world tree
types: enchantment
activated[1]: discard a land card: CARDNAME deals 2 damage to any target.
triggered: whenever you discard a land card, exile the top card of your library. you may play that card this turn.
